g.title: ERD
g.text: CLINIQ database: all 48 tables (approved, ADR-057; ADR-071, 072, 073, 075 and 076 since)

clusters = owning backend module; dashed box = Spec table (not in the frontend contract yet); arrow = foreign key, pointing at the parent; same patient = composite key that forces the record and its parent to be for the same patient

g.title: users_note
g.text: most tables also point at users
